-- Mini-ERP: fixed asset register + straight-line depreciation. The COA
-- already had a "1-500 Peralatan" account but nothing ever wrote to it —
-- equipment purchases were being expensed in full via Keuangan instead of
-- capitalized and depreciated over time.
--
-- Adds "1-501 Akumulasi Penyusutan" as an aset-type account with
-- normal_balance = 'debit' (matching every other aset account) even though
-- it's only ever *credited* — that's deliberate: this app's Neraca sums every
-- aset account's balance directly into Total Aset with no per-account
-- sign-flipping, so keeping normal_balance='debit' here means its balance
-- goes negative as depreciation accrues, which correctly *reduces* Total
-- Aset without needing any special-cased contra-account handling elsewhere.
create or replace function private.seed_default_accounts(p_business_id uuid)
returns void
language plpgsql
security definer
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  insert into public.accounts (business_id, code, name, type, normal_balance, is_system)
  values
    (p_business_id, '1-001', 'Kas & Bank', 'aset', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '1-100', 'Piutang Usaha', 'aset', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '1-200', 'Persediaan', 'aset', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '1-500', 'Peralatan', 'aset', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '1-501', 'Akumulasi Penyusutan', 'aset', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '2-001', 'Utang Dagang', 'kewajiban', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '2-100', 'Utang Gaji', 'kewajiban', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '2-200', 'PPN Keluaran (Utang Pajak)', 'kewajiban', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '3-001', 'Modal Pemilik', 'modal', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '3-100', 'Laba Ditahan', 'modal', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '4-001', 'Pendapatan Penjualan', 'pendapatan', 'kredit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-001', 'Beban Pokok Penjualan (HPP)', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-100', 'Beban Gaji', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-101', 'Beban Listrik & Air', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-102', 'Beban Sewa', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-103', 'Beban Marketing', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-104', 'Beban Perlengkapan', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-105', 'Beban Penyusutan', 'beban', 'debit', true),
    (p_business_id, '5-999', 'Beban Lain-lain', 'beban', 'debit', true)
  on conflict (business_id, code) do nothing;
end;
$$;

do $$
declare
  b record;
begin
  for b in select id from public.businesses loop
    perform private.seed_default_accounts(b.id);
  end loop;
end;
$$;

create table public.fixed_assets (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  purchase_date date not null,
  cost numeric(14, 2) not null check (cost > 0),
  useful_life_months int not null check (useful_life_months > 0),
  salvage_value numeric(14, 2) not null default 0 check (salvage_value >= 0),
  accumulated_depreciation numeric(14, 2) not null default 0,
  disposed_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index fixed_assets_business_id_idx on public.fixed_assets (business_id);

alter table public.fixed_assets enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages fixed assets of own businesses"
on public.fixed_assets for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

-- One row per business per calendar month depreciation was posted, so the
-- same month can never be double-posted.
create table public.depreciation_postings (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  period date not null, -- first day of the depreciated month
  total_amount numeric(14, 2) not null,
  journal_entry_id uuid references public.journal_entries (id) on delete set null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (business_id, period)
);

create index depreciation_postings_business_id_idx on public.depreciation_postings (business_id, period desc);

alter table public.depreciation_postings enable row level security;

create policy "Owner views depreciation postings of own businesses"
on public.depreciation_postings for select
using (private.owns_business(business_id));

-- Mini-ERP: rekonsiliasi rekening kas/bank. Snapshot-only tool — bandingkan
-- saldo menurut jurnal (buku) vs saldo menurut rekening koran/kas fisik pada
-- suatu tanggal, simpan selisihnya sebagai riwayat. Tidak mengubah jurnal
-- sama sekali (beda dari Transfer Kas/Bank yang memposting entri) — murni
-- alat diagnosa, jadi cukup insert langsung dari client seperti fixed_assets,
-- tanpa RPC security-definer.
create table public.account_reconciliations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  account_id uuid not null references public.accounts (id) on delete cascade,
  statement_date date not null,
  book_balance numeric(14, 2) not null,
  statement_balance numeric(14, 2) not null,
  difference numeric(14, 2) not null,
  note text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index account_reconciliations_business_account_idx
  on public.account_reconciliations (business_id, account_id, statement_date desc);

alter table public.account_reconciliations enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages account reconciliations of own businesses"
on public.account_reconciliations for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
with check (private.owns_business(business_id));

The KasirKu project uses a hosted Supabase project (URL in `.env.local`), but `npx supabase migration list --linked` fails with LegacyProjectNotLinkedError — the CLI is not linked on this machine.

**Why:** New files in `supabase/migrations/` do not reach the database automatically; features silently fall back (e.g. missing RPCs return null) until applied.

**How to apply:** After adding a migration, remind the user (m.khamdannn91@gmail.com) to paste its SQL into the Supabase dashboard SQL Editor. As of 2026-07-03 all migrations through `20260702101100_self_order_rpc.sql` are applied (user ran the self-order RPC one manually that day; full customer QR → POS inbox flow verified E2E). `20260703100000_void_transaction_rpc.sql` was applied by the user the same day (void flow verified E2E: PIN gating, stock restore, activity log). `20260703110000_discounts_tax_checkout.sql` was applied by the user the same day (discount/PPN/service checkout verified E2E incl. CSV export columns). `20260703120000_open_bills.sql` was applied by the user the same day (save/update/load/pay-deletes cycle verified E2E). All migrations through 20260703120000 are applied. To verify whether an RPC exists, POST to `/rest/v1/rpc/<fn>` with correct param names; PGRST202 with an empty body is a false negative.

`20260704100000_stock_adjustments.sql` (adds `stock_adjustments` table for the stok opname/adjustment feature) was applied by the user on 2026-07-04. All migrations through 20260704100000 are applied.

`20260704200000_customers.sql` (adds `customers` table, `transactions.customer_id`, and redefines `checkout_transaction` with an 8th optional `p_customer_id` param) was applied by the user on 2026-07-04. All migrations through 20260704200000 are applied.

`20260704300000_low_stock_threshold.sql` (adds `min_stock` to `products` and `ingredients` for the low-stock notification feature) was applied by the user on 2026-07-04. All migrations through 20260704300000 are applied.

`20260705100000_cashier_management.sql` (adds `reset_cashier_pin` RPC) was applied by the user on 2026-07-05. All migrations through 20260705100000 are applied.

As of 2026-07-08, migrations `20260706100000_payroll.sql` through `20260707100000_ticket_checkin.sql` status is unconfirmed (not verified this session). `20260708100000_link_self_order_checkout.sql` (redefines `checkout_transaction` with a 9th `p_self_order_ids uuid[]` param that marks self_orders 'selesai' and stamps `transactions.table_id` on checkout) was applied by the user on 2026-07-08 and verified E2E in browser preview: QR order → POS inbox "+ Ke Kasir" → checkout → self_order auto-flips to 'selesai' and disappears from the inbox with no manual "✓ Selesai" click needed. All migrations through 20260708100000 are applied.

`20260708200000_admin_panel.sql` (adds `public.admins` table + `private.is_admin()` + security-definer RPCs `admin_stats()`/`admin_list_businesses()` for the new read-only `/admin` superadmin panel, see [[project-purpose-saas-product]]) **applied and verified 2026-07-09**. Melan signed up his first real owner account (m.khamdannn91@gmail.com, uid `3b8dcecf-db11-4aa1-b1cb-9ae3e4197c95`) via `/signup` — his first-ever account in the app, per [[project-purpose-saas-product]] — then was seeded into `public.admins` via the dashboard SQL Editor. `/admin` confirmed working in browser preview: shows stats (4 toko, 3 pemilik, F&B/Retail/Tiket breakdown) and full tenant list.

Three more migrations for the new accounting/mini-ERP module (see [[mini-erp-scope]]):
- `20260708300000_accounting_core.sql` — `accounts`, `journal_entries`, `journal_lines` tables, default COA seeded per business (trigger + backfill), `private.post_journal()` helper, `public.post_journal_entry()` manual-entry RPC. **Confirmed applied 2026-07-08**: Daftar Akun page shows all 15 seeded accounts for Toko Test Laporan, and a manual journal entry via the Jurnal page posted successfully and balanced.
- `20260708300100_checkout_void_journal_posting.sql` — redefines `checkout_transaction` (same 9-param signature, now also auto-posts a sales journal entry) and `void_transaction` (posts a reversing entry). **Confirmed applied and working 2026-07-08**: did a real POS sale (Roti Bakar, INV-20260708-0003, Rp19.058) and it auto-posted "Penjualan INV-20260708-0003" — debit Kas & Bank / credit Pendapatan Penjualan Rp19.058, no HPP lines since Roti Bakar has no recipe cost yet (expected). Neraca then showed Total Aset = Total Modal (Laba Berjalan) = Rp19.058, balanced.
- `20260708300200_budgets.sql` — `public.budgets` table for the Target vs Aktual report. **Correction 2026-07-09**: despite the earlier note that this was "applied alongside 300100", it had NOT actually been applied — the Anggaran page failed with `Could not find the table 'public.budgets' in the schema cache` when setting a target. User re-ran this migration's SQL in the dashboard SQL Editor on 2026-07-09 and it's now confirmed applied and working: set a Rp100.000 target for "Beban Lain-lain" (2026-07), Anggaran page correctly showed Aktual Rp50.000 (pulled from the journal), variance -Rp50.000, "50% dari target" in green (under-budget is good for beban). Lesson: don't trust a migration's "applied" status carried over from a prior session's note without re-verifying — confirm by actually exercising the feature.

Void auto-reversal **confirmed working 2026-07-08**: voided INV-20260708-0003 (manager PIN 9999 / Manajer Test) and a "Void INV-20260708-0003" journal entry posted automatically with debit/credit swapped from the original sale (debit Pendapatan Penjualan / credit Kas & Bank, Rp19.058) — Neraca's Kas & Bank correctly went back to Rp0 afterward.

Expense auto-posting **confirmed working 2026-07-09**: added a "Lain-lain" expense of Rp50.000 via the Keuangan page (Toko Test Laporan) and it correctly posted debit 5-999 (Beban Lain-lain) / credit 1-001 (Kas & Bank), Rp50.000 each. Neraca updated and stayed balanced (Total Aset = Total Modal = -Rp50.000, "✓ Aset = Kewajiban + Modal (seimbang)"). Still unverified: the Anggaran/budgets UI actually saving+reading a target.

Note: hit a stale-Turbopack-cache issue mid-session where every nested route under `(dashboard)` (finance, accounting/*, reports/*) 404'd on both full page loads and client nav, while the group's own index page still worked — `rm -rf .next` + dev server restart fixed it. If nested dashboard routes 404 unexpectedly again, try this before assuming a code bug.

`20260709100000_ingredient_price_history.sql` (new `ingredient_price_history` table for the Tren Harga feature, see [[mini-erp-scope]]) — **applied and verified 2026-07-09**. Note: pasting the migration via a Bash `cat` command backfired once — the user accidentally pasted the shell command itself (`$ cat "G:\...\...sql"`) into the SQL Editor instead of its output. Since then, prefer using the Read tool and putting the raw SQL directly in a fenced code block in chat, not routing it through a shell command the user might copy verbatim.

`20260709110000_suppliers_purchases.sql` (`suppliers`, `purchases`, `purchase_payments` tables for the Supplier & Hutang feature, see [[mini-erp-scope]]) — **applied and verified 2026-07-09**, full purchase-to-payment-to-balance-sheet flow confirmed working in browser.

`20260710100000_payslip_paid.sql` (`payslips.paid_at`) and `20260710110000_payslip_thr_lembur.sql` (`payslips.lembur_amount`/`thr_amount`) — both **applied and verified 2026-07-10**, payroll auto-posting and THR/Lembur first-class fields confirmed working end-to-end in browser (see [[mini-erp-scope]]).

`20260710120000_receivables.sql` (`receivables`, `receivable_payments` tables for the Piutang Pelanggan/AR feature, see [[mini-erp-scope]]) — **applied and verified 2026-07-10**. Note: the user's first attempt to paste it hit `ERROR: 42P07: relation "receivables" already exists` — turned out the migration had already succeeded on an earlier paste (confirmed via `information_schema.columns` and `pg_policies` checks showing both tables + both RLS policies fully present), so the error was just a harmless re-run, not a failed migration. If this happens again, check actual DB state before assuming failure.

`20260710130000_period_closing.sql` (`period_closings` table + `close_accounting_period()` RPC + adds `'tutup_buku'` to `journal_entries.source`'s check constraint, for the Tutup Buku feature, see [[mini-erp-scope]]) — **applied and verified 2026-07-10**, full close-period flow confirmed working end-to-end in browser (Laba Berjalan → Laba Ditahan transfer, balanced closing journal entry, Neraca stayed balanced).

`20260710140000_ppn_liability.sql` (adds `2-200 PPN Keluaran` account + redefines `checkout_transaction`/`void_transaction` to book PPN as a liability instead of revenue, see [[mini-erp-scope]]) — **applied and verified 2026-07-10**.

`20260710150000_fixed_assets_depreciation.sql` (`fixed_assets`, `depreciation_postings` tables + `1-501 Akumulasi Penyusutan`/`5-105 Beban Penyusutan` accounts) and its follow-up fix `20260710160000_fix_depreciation_postings_rls.sql` (depreciation_postings needed a `for all` owner policy, not select-only — see [[mini-erp-scope]] for the double-posting incident this RLS gap caused and how it was corrected) — **both applied and verified 2026-07-10**, straight-line depreciation posting confirmed working end-to-end after the fix.

```sql
-- Mini-ERP: rekonsiliasi rekening kas/bank. Snapshot-only tool — bandingkan
-- saldo menurut jurnal (buku) vs saldo menurut rekening koran/kas fisik pada
-- suatu tanggal, simpan selisihnya sebagai riwayat. Tidak mengubah jurnal
-- sama sekali (beda dari Transfer Kas/Bank yang memposting entri) — murni
-- alat diagnosa, jadi cukup insert langsung dari client seperti fixed_assets,
-- tanpa RPC security-definer.
create table public.account_reconciliations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  account_id uuid not null references public.accounts (id) on delete cascade,
  statement_date date not null,
  book_balance numeric(14, 2) not null,
  statement_balance numeric(14, 2) not null,
  difference numeric(14, 2) not null,
  note text,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index account_reconciliations_business_account_idx
  on public.account_reconciliations (business_id, account_id, statement_date desc);

alter table public.account_reconciliations enable row level security;

create policy "Owner manages account reconciliations of own businesses"
on public.account_reconciliations for all
using (private.owns_business(business_id))
```

**Rekonsiliasi Rekening (bank/cash reconciliation) — built and verified E2E 2026-07-12**: closes the last known gap from the 2026-07-10 accounting-lens list (real bank-statement matching, distinct from the existing per-payment-method reconciliation in `finance/page.tsx`). Scoped down deliberately (user didn't respond to a design-choice question, so proceeded with the recommended lightweight option, same "doesn't need to be complete" pattern as Transfer Kas/Bank): a snapshot-only diagnostic tool, not full per-transaction clearing/matching. New table `public.account_reconciliations` (migration `20260712100000_account_reconciliations.sql`, see [[supabase-migrations-manual]]) — id, business_id, account_id, statement_date, book_balance, statement_balance, difference, note; RLS `for all using/with check owns_business` (direct client insert, no RPC needed since this never touches the ledger). New page `accounting/rekonsiliasi/page.tsx` ("🏦 Rekonsiliasi Rekening" in Akuntansi, between Transfer Kas/Bank and Tutup Buku): pick an aset-type account + as-of date, shows book balance (same as-of-date calc as Neraca, scoped to one account), a form to record the statement/physical-cash balance + optional note (saves a history row, difference = statement − book), a diagnostic list of that account's journal mutations since the last reconciliation for it (or 30 days back if none yet) to help explain any gap, and a per-account reconciliation history list. `actions.ts`/`reconciliation-form.tsx` use the resetToken/key-remount pattern from the start (not the old useEffect+ref.reset() pattern, since that was just fixed for lint elsewhere same day).
- Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": Kas & Bank book balance −Rp3.516.942; entered −Rp3.500.000 as statement balance → saved "Selisih Rp16.942" (red); entered −Rp3.516.942 exactly → saved "✓ Cocok" (green); switched account to Bank BCA via the GET filter form → book balance correctly Rp500.000 (matches the earlier Transfer Kas/Bank test), diagnostic list correctly scoped to only that account's mutations, history correctly empty/separate per account. Form reset to blank after successful save.
- Tooling note confirming an existing pattern: the first submit click after page load silently no-op'd (no POST fired, confirmed via network log), textbook hydration race already documented in [[test-account-preview]]/[[mini-erp-scope]] purchases section — second click (or a JS `.click()`/`.requestSubmit()`) worked immediately. Not a bug in the new feature.

content.content:
40	
41	**Piutang Pelanggan (customer receivables/AR) — built and verified E2E 2026-07-10**: mirrors the Supplier & Hutang pattern exactly but reversed (credit sales where the customer pays later, additive/separate from POS checkout which only supports full payment at sale time). Migration `20260710120000_receivables.sql` adds `public.receivables` (customer_id nullable → `customers`, date, description, amount, paid_amount with a `paid_amount <= amount` check) and `public.receivable_payments` (installment log), both RLS-gated by `private.owns_business`. New page `receivables/page.tsx` (record a receivable — customer optional, description, total amount, "Belum Bayar Sama Sekali"/"Bayar Sebagian" toggle — plus a "+ Terima Bayar" inline form per unpaid row, structurally identical to `purchases/page.tsx`). `receivables/actions.ts` `addReceivable` posts a journal entry (debit 1-001 Kas & Bank for whatever's paid now + debit 1-100 Piutang Usaha for the remainder, credit 4-001 Pendapatan Penjualan for the full amount — inverse of the purchase entry); `addReceivablePayment` posts debit 1-001/credit 1-100 per installment, rejecting overpayment past the remaining balance. `customers/page.tsx` now shows an amber "Piutang RpX" badge per customer (computed the same way `suppliers/page.tsx` shows its utang badge). Nav: "💳 Piutang Pelanggan" added to the Operasional sidebar group next to Pelanggan/Pembelian/Supplier.
42	- Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": recorded a Rp500.000 receivable ("Jual 2 karung beras", no customer selected) with Rp200.000 paid now → journal posted debit Kas & Bank 200rb + debit Piutang Usaha 300rb / credit Pendapatan Penjualan 500rb (3-line entry, balanced). Paid the remaining Rp300.000 via "+ Terima Bayar" → journal posted debit Kas & Bank 300rb / credit Piutang Usaha 300rb, row flipped to "Lunas", Total Piutang Usaha back to Rp0. Neraca confirmed balanced throughout (✓ Aset = Kewajiban + Modal), Piutang Usaha line correctly returned to Rp0 after full payment. Customers page renders without crash (no badge shown for the unrelated existing customer, as expected since the test receivable wasn't tied to any customer_id).
43	
44	**Formula audit — 2026-07-09**, after all the above was built, ran 4 parallel Explore agents auditing every calculation in the app (POS checkout/merchant-fee, HPP/COGS/weighted-avg cost, accounting/journal/balance-sheet, payroll/shift-close/ticket-pricing). Most formulas checked out clean (checkout math, weighted-average cost, Neraca arithmetic, Anggaran variance, payroll, shift-close, ticket pricing — the last one has existing passing unit tests, 38/38). **4 real bugs found, 1 fixed so far:**
45	1. **FIXED (commit bdbe337)**: Arus Kas (`accounting/arus-kas/page.tsx`) bucketed cash flow by `journal_entries.source`, but `public.post_journal_entry` (used by every purchase and expense posting, not just true manual entries) always writes `source='manual'` — so nearly all purchases/expenses were misclassified into "Investasi & Pendanaan" instead of "Operasional". Fixed by classifying by the counterparty account's type/code instead (modal→Pendanaan, Peralatan 1-500→Investasi, else→Operasional). Verified in browser: Beban Lain-lain, Bayar Utang Dagang, and a cash Persediaan purchase all correctly moved to "Aktivitas Operasional".
46	2. **FIXED (commit b928d51)**: `recalculateProductCost()` (`products/[productId]/recipe/actions.ts`) only used to re-fire on recipe line add/remove — never when an ingredient's `unit_cost` changed via `ingredients/actions.ts` `editIngredient`, `finance/actions.ts` `addExpense`, or `purchases/actions.ts` `addPurchase`, so `products.cost` (and downstream, `transaction_items.cost` snapshotted at sale time → COGS Teori) silently went stale. Fixed by extracting the calc into `src/lib/recalculate-product-cost.ts` (`recalculateProductCost` + a new `recalculateProductCostsForIngredient` that finds every product referencing a given ingredient and recalcs each) and calling the ingredient-scoped version from all three write sites whenever `unit_cost` actually changes. Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": added Gula Pasir (50gr) to Roti Bakar's recipe (HPP → Rp1.350 at Rp27/gr), then edited Gula Pasir's price to Rp100/gr manually — Roti Bakar's HPP updated to Rp5.000 without touching the recipe. Then bought 100gr more via the Pembelian page (weighted avg → Rp106/gr) — HPP updated again to Rp5.300, confirming all three trigger paths work.
47	3. **FIXED (commit e02e62d, migration `20260709120000_fix_zero_total_hpp_posting.sql`)**: `checkout_transaction` only posted a journal entry `if v_total > 0`, but stock/ingredient consumption happens unconditionally — a 100%-discounted sale reduced inventory with no HPP/Persediaan journal line at all. Fixed by decoupling the Kas & Bank/Pendapatan lines (posted only when `v_total > 0`) from the HPP/Persediaan lines (posted independently whenever `v_total_cost > 0`), building `v_journal_lines` incrementally and only calling `private.post_journal` if at least 2 lines ended up in it. Mirrored the identical fix in `void_transaction`'s reversing entry. Verified end-to-end in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": sold 1 Roti Bakar (HPP Rp5.300) with a 100% order discount (INV-20260709-0001, total Rp0) — jurnal correctly posted a 2-line entry (debit 5-001 HPP / credit 1-200 Persediaan, Rp5.300, no Kas & Bank/Pendapatan lines). Then voided it with manager PIN — reversing entry correctly posted debit 1-200 / credit 5-001, Rp5.300. Neraca stayed balanced throughout.
48	4. **FIXED (commit 23c83ca)**: `purchases/actions.ts` and `finance/actions.ts` called the `post_journal_entry` RPC via `supabase.rpc(...)` without checking `{ error }`. Now `postExpenseJournal`/`postPurchaseJournal` return the error message (or null) instead of swallowing it, and both call sites plus the utang-payment RPC call in `addPurchasePayment` check it: on failure they log a `"warning"` activity entry (instead of the usual success level) with the error text, and return a form error telling the user the record saved but a manual correcting journal entry is needed at Akuntansi → Jurnal. Verified no regression on the happy path (a normal "Lain-lain" expense still saved silently with no error banner). The failure path itself wasn't exercised (would need deliberately breaking an account code) but the logic is a straightforward null-check/ternary, low risk.

**Formula audit — 2026-07-09**, after all the above was built, ran 4 parallel Explore agents auditing every calculation in the app (POS checkout/merchant-fee, HPP/COGS/weighted-avg cost, accounting/journal/balance-sheet, payroll/shift-close/ticket-pricing). Most formulas checked out clean (checkout math, weighted-average cost, Neraca arithmetic, Anggaran variance, payroll, shift-close, ticket pricing — the last one has existing passing unit tests, 38/38). **4 real bugs found, 1 fixed so far:**
1. **FIXED (commit bdbe337)**: Arus Kas (`accounting/arus-kas/page.tsx`) bucketed cash flow by `journal_entries.source`, but `public.post_journal_entry` (used by every purchase and expense posting, not just true manual entries) always writes `source='manual'` — so nearly all purchases/expenses were misclassified into "Investasi & Pendanaan" instead of "Operasional". Fixed by classifying by the counterparty account's type/code instead (modal→Pendanaan, Peralatan 1-500→Investasi, else→Operasional). Verified in browser: Beban Lain-lain, Bayar Utang Dagang, and a cash Persediaan purchase all correctly moved to "Aktivitas Operasional".
2. **FIXED (commit b928d51)**: `recalculateProductCost()` (`products/[productId]/recipe/actions.ts`) only used to re-fire on recipe line add/remove — never when an ingredient's `unit_cost` changed via `ingredients/actions.ts` `editIngredient`, `finance/actions.ts` `addExpense`, or `purchases/actions.ts` `addPurchase`, so `products.cost` (and downstream, `transaction_items.cost` snapshotted at sale time → COGS Teori) silently went stale. Fixed by extracting the calc into `src/lib/recalculate-product-cost.ts` (`recalculateProductCost` + a new `recalculateProductCostsForIngredient` that finds every product referencing a given ingredient and recalcs each) and calling the ingredient-scoped version from all three write sites whenever `unit_cost` actually changes. Verified in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": added Gula Pasir (50gr) to Roti Bakar's recipe (HPP → Rp1.350 at Rp27/gr), then edited Gula Pasir's price to Rp100/gr manually — Roti Bakar's HPP updated to Rp5.000 without touching the recipe. Then bought 100gr more via the Pembelian page (weighted avg → Rp106/gr) — HPP updated again to Rp5.300, confirming all three trigger paths work.
3. **FIXED (commit e02e62d, migration `20260709120000_fix_zero_total_hpp_posting.sql`)**: `checkout_transaction` only posted a journal entry `if v_total > 0`, but stock/ingredient consumption happens unconditionally — a 100%-discounted sale reduced inventory with no HPP/Persediaan journal line at all. Fixed by decoupling the Kas & Bank/Pendapatan lines (posted only when `v_total > 0`) from the HPP/Persediaan lines (posted independently whenever `v_total_cost > 0`), building `v_journal_lines` incrementally and only calling `private.post_journal` if at least 2 lines ended up in it. Mirrored the identical fix in `void_transaction`'s reversing entry. Verified end-to-end in browser on "Toko Test Laporan": sold 1 Roti Bakar (HPP Rp5.300) with a 100% order discount (INV-20260709-0001, total Rp0) — jurnal correctly posted a 2-line entry (debit 5-001 HPP / credit 1-200 Persediaan, Rp5.300, no Kas & Bank/Pendapatan lines). Then voided it with manager PIN — reversing entry correctly posted debit 1-200 / credit 5-001, Rp5.300. Neraca stayed balanced throughout.
4. **FIXED (commit 23c83ca)**: `purchases/actions.ts` and `finance/actions.ts` called the `post_journal_entry` RPC via `supabase.rpc(...)` without checking `{ error }`. Now `postExpenseJournal`/`postPurchaseJournal` return the error message (or null) instead of swallowing it, and both call sites plus the utang-payment RPC call in `addPurchasePayment` check it: on failure they log a `"warning"` activity entry (instead of the usual success level) with the error text, and return a form error telling the user the record saved but a manual correcting journal entry is needed at Akuntansi → Jurnal. Verified no regression on the happy path (a normal "Lain-lain" expense still saved silently with no error banner). The failure path itself wasn't exercised (would need deliberately breaking an account code) but the logic is a straightforward null-check/ternary, low risk.

**Absent entirely.** No code, schema, or dependency related to subscription billing exists anywhere in the repo.

Biaya dan Pembayaran") explicitly states billing terms **will be announced separately once a billing feature exists** ("akan diinformasikan secara terpisah pada saat fitur penagihan tersedia") — i.e., the ToS itself documents that billing is not yet built.

### 2. Signup/onboarding flow

- **Signup**: `src/app/signup/page.tsx` — plain email/password form using `supabase.auth.signUp()`. Password minimum is 6 characters (`page.tsx:26-29`). If Supabase returns no session (email confirmation required), it shows a "check your email" screen (`page.tsx:52-73`); if a session is returned immediately, it routes straight to `/onboarding`. - **Password reset**: `src/app/forgot-password` and `src/app/reset-password` routes exist (found in `src/app` listing), consistent with standard Supabase auth flows, but not read in detail.

### 3. Multi-tenant data isolation (RLS)

- Confirmed **47 tables created** via `create table public.*` across all migrations, and **47 `enable row level security` statements** — one-to-one, no gaps.
- Confirmed **48 `create policy` statements**; cross-checking every created table against policy references found exactly **one table with no policy**: `public.admins` (`supabase/migrations/20260708200000_admin_panel.sql:8-15`) — this is intentional and documented in the migration's own comment ("Intentionally no policies: this table is only ever read via the security-definer functions below, never queried directly by clients").
- Sampled the `private.owns_business(business_id)` pattern across the full time range of migrations — it is consistent from the earliest (`20260702100100_businesses_and_cashiers.sql`, `20260702100200_products_ingredients_recipes.sql`) through the middle (`20260706200000_ticket_venue.sql`) to the most recent (`20260710120000_receivables.sql`, `20260712100000_account_reconciliations.sql`). Every sampled policy follows the same shape:
  ```sql
  using (private.owns_business(business_id))
  with check (private.owns_business(business_id))
  ```
  Child tables without a direct `business_id` column (e.g. `product_recipes`, `self_order_items`) join back to the parent and call `private.owns_business(parent.business_id)` inside the policy subquery instead.
- The customer-facing self-order surface (`supabase/migrations/20260702101100_self_order_rpc.sql`) intentionally grants `execute` on `get_self_order_menu` and `submit_self_order` to the `anon` role (lines 56, 131) — this is a deliberate, narrow anonymous-access RPC path (QR-code ordering) rather than a hole in RLS, gated by a random `qr_slug` per the migration's own comment.

### 4. Legal/compliance pages

- `src/app/terms/page.tsx` and `src/app/privacy/page.tsx` exist and are linked from the landing page footer and the signup form (`src/app/signup/page.tsx:148-158`).
- Both pages carry an explicit disclaimer banner marking them as drafts:
  - Terms (`terms/page.tsx:113-117`): "dokumen ini adalah draf awal ... belum ditinjau oleh konsultan hukum" (this document is an initial draft ... not yet reviewed by legal counsel).
  - Privacy (`privacy/page.tsx:110-115`): same disclaimer, additionally naming **UU PDP** (Indonesia's data protection law) as something requiring review — i.e., the document itself states it has not been checked for UU PDP compliance.
- Privacy policy section 9 (`privacy/page.tsx:61-65`) states only essential session cookies are used ("Cookie ini bersifat esensial ... bukan untuk pelacakan iklan") — there is **no cookie-consent banner** anywhere in the codebase (not searched as a separate component, but none appeared in `page.tsx`, `middleware.ts`, or layout files reviewed).
- No refund-policy page exists; the ToS billing section (section 4) defers this to a future "penagihan" (billing) feature.
- No dedicated "Data Processing Agreement" or DPA route found.

### 5. Production hardening basics

- `.env.example` (full contents): `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`. `.env.local` has the same three variable names populated (values not read/printed). No other env vars (no email-provider keys, no payment-gateway keys, no Sentry DSN, no rate-limit/Redis config).
- `package.json` dependencies: `@supabase/ssr`, `@supabase/supabase-js`, `jsbarcode`, `lucide-react`, `next`, `react`, `react-dom`. Dev deps: Tailwind, ESLint, TypeScript, Vitest. **No** Sentry/error-monitoring package, **no** rate-limiting package (no Upstash, no `rate-limit` libs), **no** transactional-email package (no Resend, SendGrid, Nodemailer, Postmark). Confirmed absent in `package-lock.json` as well (grep for these names returned nothing).
- `next.config.ts` is the unmodified default (`{ /* config options here */ }`) — no security headers, no CSP, no image domain allowlist, nothing custom.
- Middleware: the actual Next.js middleware entry point is `src/proxy.ts` (Next 16 renamed the file from `middleware.ts`; it exports `proxy()` and a `matcher` config excluding static assets). It delegates to `src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts`'s `updateSession()`, which: refreshes the Supabase auth session/cookies, defines public paths (`/login`, `/signup`, `/forgot-password`, `/`, `/order/*`, `/auth/callback`, `/terms`, `/privacy`), redirects unauthenticated users on non-public paths to `/login`, and redirects authenticated users away from auth pages to `/dashboard`. This is **auth gating only** — no rate limiting, no bot protection, no IP throttling of any kind.

### 6. Landing/marketing page

- `src/app/page.tsx` is a full public marketing landing page (Indonesian-language), not a redirect-to-login. It includes: a nav with "Masuk" (login) / "Daftar Gratis" (sign up free) links, a hero section, a "Dibuat untuk jenis usahamu" section listing the three business types (F&B, Retail, Tempat Wisata/Tiket), an 8-item feature grid (`FEATURES` array, `page.tsx:29-70`), a CTA section, and a footer linking to `/terms` and `/privacy`.
- If a user is already authenticated, `page.tsx:76-82` redirects them server-side to `/dashboard`.
- **No pricing section or pricing page exists** — the word "Gratis" (free) appears only in CTA button copy ("Daftar Gratis", "Mulai Gratis", "Daftar gratis dan mulai pakai dalam hitungan menit"), consistent with there being no paid-plan mechanism yet (see section 1). There is no `/pricing` route anywhere in `src/app`.</result>

content.text:
Audit selesai. Jawaban singkatnya: **belum siap dipublikasikan secara luas** — bukan karena kualitas fitur POS/akuntansinya (itu sudah matang), tapi karena **sistem pembayaran pelanggan-ke-kamu belum ada sama sekali**, yang artinya secara harfiah belum ada cara bagi pemilik usaha lain untuk membayar kamu.

## 🚫 Blocker utama: Sistem langganan/billing — nihil total

- Tabel `businesses` tidak punya kolom plan/subscription/trial apa pun
- Tidak ada integrasi payment gateway (Midtrans/Xendit/dll) — nol dependency, nol kode
- Panel `/admin` cuma **read-only** (lihat statistik semua tenant) — tidak bisa kelola langganan, tidak bisa suspend akun yang menunggak, tidak ada daftar invoice
- Menariknya, [Terms of Service](src/app/terms/page.tsx:28) kamu sendiri sudah mengakui ini — bagian "Biaya dan Pembayaran" bilang akan diumumkan terpisah "pada saat fitur penagihan tersedia"
- Tidak ada feature-gating (fitur yang dibatasi/dibuka sesuai paket)
- Tidak ada halaman pricing — landing page cuma bilang "Daftar Gratis", tidak ada harga ditampilkan

Ini yang harus dibangun dulu sebelum bisa jualan sungguhan, bukan cuma "kurang dikit".

## ⚠️ Hal lain yang perlu diberesin sebelum go-live luas

1. **Legal**: Terms & Privacy Policy masih [draf awal](src/app/terms/page.tsx:113), eksplisit bilang "belum ditinjau konsultan hukum" dan belum dicek kepatuhan UU PDP. Untuk publikasi luas ke publik Indonesia, ini idealnya direview dulu.
2. **Celah kecil di onboarding**: `/onboarding` cuma redirect kalau user sudah punya 1 bisnis, tapi server action `createBusiness` sendiri tidak menolak — kalau di-hit langsung (bukan lewat UI), user bisa bikin bisnis kedua tanpa batas maupun bayar. Perlu diputuskan: mau dilarang (butuh limit di server action), atau justru fitur legit untuk paket tertentu (multi-toko per akun)?
3. **Tidak ada proteksi brute-force/spam** di signup & login — hanya auth gating biasa, tidak ada rate limiting.
4. **Tidak ada email transaksional** (welcome email dll) — cuma mengandalkan template default Supabase Auth.
5. **Tidak ada error monitoring** (Sentry dkk) — kalau ada bug produksi yang dialami pelanggan bayar, kamu baru tahu kalau mereka komplain.

## ✅ Yang sudah solid, tidak perlu dikhawatirkan

- **Keamanan multi-tenant**: 47 tabel, semua RLS aktif dan konsisten pakai pola `owns_business()` — tidak ada celah data bocor antar tenant (satu-satunya tabel tanpa policy, `admins`, memang sengaja dan aman)
- Landing page publik, wizard onboarding jenis usaha (F&B/Retail/Tiket), alur auth (signup/login/lupa password) — semua sudah berfungsi baik
- Fitur produk (POS, akuntansi, HPP, payroll, dll) — sudah sangat matang, jauh melebihi kebutuhan minimum

Bagian tersulit dan paling menentukan sekarang adalah **desain sistem langganan**: pilihan payment gateway (di Indonesia biasanya Midtrans atau Xendit), struktur paket/harga, dan bagaimana grace period untuk yang telat bayar. Ini keputusan bisnis yang perlu kamu tentukan dulu sebelum saya bisa mulai coding.

## 1. `businesses` table schema (full, as of latest migrations)

Base table — `supabase/migrations/20260702100100_businesses_and_cashiers.sql`:

```sql
create table public.businesses (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  owner_id uuid not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  name text not null,
  business_type text not null check (business_type in ('fnb', 'retail')),
  address text,
  phone text,
  npwp text,
  logo_url text,
  tax_enabled boolean not null default false,
  tax_rate numeric(5, 2) not null default 0,
  service_enabled boolean not null default false,
  service_rate numeric(5, 2) not null default 0,
  auto_lock_enabled boolean not null default true,

  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create index businesses_owner_id_idx on public.businesses (owner_id);
alter table public.businesses enable row level security;

create policy "Owner has full access to own businesses"
on public.businesses for all
using (owner_id = auth.uid())
with check (owner_id = auth.uid());
```

Also defined in that migration — the reusable RLS helper you'd reuse for billing tables too:

```sql
create or replace function private.owns_business(check_business_id uuid)
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.businesses b
    where b.id = check_business_id and b.owner_id = auth.uid()
  );
$$;
```

Only one later migration ALTERs `businesses` — `supabase/migrations/20260706200000_ticket_venue.sql` (lines 7-12), and it only widens the `business_type` check constraint, no new columns:

```sql
alter table public.businesses
  drop constraint if exists businesses_business_type_check;

alter table public.businesses
  add constraint businesses_business_type_check
  check (business_type in ('fnb', 'retail', 'tiket'));
```

No other migration touches `businesses`. There are currently **no** billing/subscription columns (no `plan`, `status`, `trial_ends_at`, `subscription_expires_at`, etc.) — none exist yet.

## 2. Admin panel implementation

`src/app/admin/page.tsx` (full file, 181 lines) — a Server Component that calls two RPCs in parallel and calls `notFound()` on any error (so non-admins just see a 404, no explicit redirect):

```tsx
const [{ data: stats, error: statsError }, { data: businesses, error: listError }] =
  await Promise.all([
    supabase.rpc("admin_stats").single(),
    supabase.rpc("admin_list_businesses"),
  ]);

if (statsError || listError || !stats) {
  notFound();
}
```

There is **no `src/app/admin/layout.tsx`** — gating happens purely inside the page component via the RPCs raising `not authorized`, which surfaces as a Supabase error and triggers `notFound()`. No middleware-level admin check either (proxy.ts/middleware.ts don't reference `/admin` at all).

`supabase/migrations/20260708200000_admin_panel.sql` (full file, 111 lines):

```sql

  user_id uuid primary key references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
alter table public.admins enable row level security;
-- Intentionally no policies: only ever read via security-definer functions below.

create or replace function private.is_admin()
returns boolean
language sql
security definer
stable
set search_path = ''
as $$
  select exists (select 1 from public.admins a where a.user_id = auth.uid());
$$;

create or replace function public.admin_stats()
returns table (
  total_businesses bigint, total_owners bigint, fnb_count bigint,
  retail_count bigint, tiket_count bigint, tx_today bigint, new_businesses_7d bigint
)
language plpgsql security definer stable set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if not private.is_admin() then raise exception 'not authorized'; end if;
  return query select
    (select count(*) from public.businesses),
    (select count(distinct owner_id) from public.businesses),
    (select count(*) from public.businesses where business_type = 'fnb'),
    (select count(*) from public.businesses where business_type = 'retail'),
    (select count(*) from public.businesses where business_type = 'tiket'),
    ( coalesce((select count(*) from public.transactions where date::date = current_date and not voided), 0)
      + coalesce((select count(*) from public.ticket_transactions where date::date = current_date and not voided), 0) ),
    (select count(*) from public.businesses where created_at >= now() - interval '7 days');
end;
$$;
grant execute on function public.admin_stats() to authenticated;

create or replace function public.admin_list_businesses()
returns table (
  id uuid, name text, business_type text, owner_email text,
  created_at timestamptz, shift_open boolean, tx_count bigint
)
language plpgsql security definer stable set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if not private.is_admin() then raise exception 'not authorized'; end if;
  return query
  select b.id, b.name, b.business_type, u.email::text, b.created_at,

    ( coalesce((select count(*) from public.transactions t where t.business_id = b.id and not t.voided), 0)

  from public.businesses b

$$;
grant execute on function public.admin_list_businesses() to authenticated;
```

# Billing: Midtrans subscription + lifetime purchase

## Context

KasirKu is meant to be sold to other business owners, but right now there is
**no way for anyone to pay** — no plan/subscription columns anywhere, no
payment gateway, no way to lock out a non-paying tenant (confirmed via a full
codebase audit: `businesses` table has zero billing columns, `/admin` is
read-only, `package.json` has no payment SDK). This is the launch blocker.
The user wants:

- Two kinds of paid plans: recurring **subscription** (bulanan/tahunan) and
  a **sekali-beli (lifetime)** one-time purchase.
- **Midtrans** as the gateway.
- **No trial** — a new business must pick and pay for a plan immediately
  after signup, before the dashboard is usable at all.
- On a subscription lapsing, a **grace period** (3 days) with a warning
  banner before the account is actually locked out.

Scope for this pass is "get a working, secure payment loop live fast," not a
full billing back-office. Plan prices are placeholders in code — the user
must edit them before going live; I have no real pricing input.

## Data model

New migration `supabase/migrations/<ts>_billing.sql`:

```sql
create table public.subscriptions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null unique references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  plan_code text not null,                 -- matches PLANS[].code in src/lib/billing/plans.ts
  status text not null default 'unpaid'
    check (status in ('unpaid', 'active', 'past_due', 'expired')),
  period_end timestamptz,                  -- null = lifetime / never expires
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
-- one row per business, mutated in place (mirrors how `businesses` itself works)

alter table public.subscriptions enable row level security;
create policy "Owner reads own subscription"
on public.subscriptions for select
using (private.owns_business(business_id));
-- no insert/update/delete policy for authenticated users: only the
-- service-role webhook and the cron sweep write to this table.

create table public.payments (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  plan_code text not null,
  order_id text not null unique,           -- sent to Midtrans as order_id
  amount numeric(14, 2) not null,
  status text not null default 'pending'
    check (status in ('pending', 'settlement', 'expire', 'cancel', 'deny')),
  midtrans_transaction_id text,
  payment_type text,
  raw_notification jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index payments_business_id_idx on public.payments (business_id, created_at desc);
alter table public.payments enable row level security;
create policy "Owner reads own payments"
on public.payments for select
using (private.owns_business(business_id));
create policy "Owner creates own pending payments"
on public.payments for insert
with check (private.owns_business(business_id) and status = 'pending');
-- updates to payments (settlement/expire/etc) only ever come from the
-- service-role webhook, which bypasses RLS — no update policy for
-- authenticated users.
```

Plan catalog lives in code, not the DB (fastest to ship; revisit if pricing
needs to change without a deploy):

`src/lib/billing/plans.ts`
```ts
export type PlanCode = "monthly" | "yearly" | "lifetime";
export const PLANS: {
  code: PlanCode; name: string; kind: "subscription" | "lifetime";
  periodDays: number | null; price: number;
}[] = [
  { code: "monthly", name: "Langganan Bulanan", kind: "subscription", periodDays: 30, price: 99000 },
  { code: "yearly", name: "Langganan Tahunan", kind: "subscription", periodDays: 365, price: 990000 },
  { code: "lifetime", name: "Sekali Bayar (Lifetime)", kind: "lifetime", periodDays: null, price: 2500000 },
];
```
(placeholder prices — flag clearly in the PR/summary that these must be edited)

## Shared status helper

`src/lib/billing/status.ts` — `getSubscriptionAccess(supabase, businessId)`
returns `{ locked: boolean; status: string; periodEnd: string | null }`.
Reads the `subscriptions` row for the business (none yet = `unpaid` =
`locked: true`). `locked` is true for `unpaid` and `expired`; false for
`active` and `past_due` (past_due only shows a warning, per the grace-period
decision). Used by both gating layouts below so the rule lives in one place.

## Enforcement (two independent layouts, no shared cross-cutting layout)

Next.js layouts can't easily detect "am I currently rendering the billing
page itself" from a parent layout, so instead of one `[businessId]/layout.tsx`
wrapping everything (which would redirect-loop on `/billing`), gate at the
two existing entry points that are NOT the billing page:

- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx`** (exists today,
  reads `business` + `userData`) — add `getSubscriptionAccess` to the same
  `Promise.all`, `redirect()` to `/business/${businessId}/billing` if
  `locked`. If `status === 'past_due'`, pass a warning flag into
  `DashboardShell` to render a dismissible-for-the-session banner ("Langganan
  jatuh tempo, bayar sebelum <periodEnd> agar tidak terkunci" + link to
  `/billing`).
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/layout.tsx`** (new file — pos has no
  layout today) — same `getSubscriptionAccess` redirect, no banner needed
  (cashiers don't need to see billing state, only the owner browsing the
  dashboard does).

`/order/*` (customer-facing self-order QR flow) is untouched — it's already
outside `/business/[businessId]` entirely per the middleware's public-path
list, so customers are never blocked by the owner's billing status.

## Billing page

`src/app/business/[businessId]/billing/page.tsx` (sibling to `(dashboard)`
and `pos`, so neither gating layout wraps it):
- Shows current status (from `getSubscriptionAccess`) and, if a subscription,
  the current `period_end`.
- Lists `PLANS` as cards with a "Bayar Sekarang" button per plan.
- `billing/actions.ts` → `createPayment(businessId, planCode)` server action:
  inserts a `payments` row (`status='pending'`, `order_id` =
  `KK-${businessId.slice(0,8)}-${Date.now()}`), calls Midtrans Snap
  (`POST https://app.midtrans.com/snap/v1/transactions`, Sandbox host in
  dev via `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION`) with Basic auth using
  `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`, gets back `redirect_url`, returns it to the client.
- `billing/pay-button.tsx` (client component): calls the action, then
  `window.location.href = redirectUrl` — plain redirect to Midtrans's hosted
  Snap page, no Snap.js popup SDK needed (keeps this consistent with the
  app's existing preference for server-rendered flows over client JS).
- After Midtrans payment, it redirects the browser back to a `finish` URL
  (e.g. `/business/${businessId}/billing?status=selesai`) — cosmetic only,
  not authoritative (the webhook is authoritative).

## Onboarding change

`src/app/onboarding/actions.ts` `createBusiness` currently redirects to
`/dashboard` after insert. Change: also insert a `subscriptions` row
(`status='unpaid'`, `plan_code=null` or a sentinel) for the new business,
then redirect to `/business/${id}/billing` instead of `/dashboard` — no
trial, so the very first thing a new owner sees is the plan picker.

## Midtrans webhook (new pattern: first service-role client in this codebase)

`src/app/api/midtrans/notification/route.ts` (new Route Handler, `POST`):
- Reads JSON body (`order_id`, `status_code`, `gross_amount`,
  `signature_key`, `transaction_status`, `payment_type`, `transaction_id`).
- Verifies `sha512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY) === signature_key`
  (Midtrans's documented scheme) — reject with 401 if it doesn't match.
- Uses a **service-role** Supabase client (new: `src/lib/supabase/service.ts`,
  `createClient` with `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, server-only, never
  imported client-side) since there's no authenticated user session in a
  webhook — this is the only file allowed to bypass RLS.
- Looks up `payments` by `order_id`. If already `settlement` (idempotency —
  Midtrans retries notifications), return 200 no-op.
- Maps `transaction_status`: `capture`/`settlement` → `payments.status =
  'settlement'`; `deny`/`cancel`/`expire` → mirror that status. Stores the
  full body in `raw_notification` for audit.
- On a fresh `settlement`: upsert `subscriptions` — `status='active'`;
  `period_end` = `null` for `lifetime`, else `now() + periodDays` (extending
  from the greater of `now()` or the existing `period_end` if renewing
  early, so early renewal doesn't lose paid-for days).
- Always returns 200 (Midtrans expects 2xx or it keeps retrying) even on a
  handled "unknown order_id" case — just skip silently, log via
  `console.error` (no activity-log table write needed for a webhook).

## Cron sweep (subscription → past_due → expired)

No cron infra exists yet (no `vercel.json`). Add:
- `vercel.json` at repo root: `{"crons": [{"path": "/api/cron/subscription-sweep", "schedule": "0 1 * * *"}]}`
  (once daily).
- `src/app/api/cron/subscription-sweep/route.ts` (`GET`): checks
  `request.headers.get("authorization") === \`Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}\``,
  403 if not (Vercel Cron sends this header when `CRON_SECRET` env var is
  set — documented Vercel behavior). Uses the service-role client:
  - `status='active' and period_end < now()` → `status='past_due'`.
  - `status='past_due' and period_end < now() - interval '3 days'` →
    `status='expired'`.
  - `lifetime` subscriptions (`period_end is null`) are never touched.

## Admin panel visibility (small extension, not a full billing back-office)

Extend `admin_list_businesses()` (migration, `create or replace function`) to
also return `subscription_status` and `plan_code` by left-joining
`subscriptions`, and add those two columns to the table in
`src/app/admin/page.tsx`. No manual-override UI in this pass — flag as a
fast-follow if the user needs to comp an account or handle an offline
bank-transfer edge case later.

## New env vars (document in `.env.example`, don't set real values)

- `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`, `MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY`, `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION`
  (`"true"`/`"false"`)
- `CRON_SECRET`
- `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` already exists in `.env.example`, just unused
  today — first real use is `src/lib/supabase/service.ts`.

## Files touched (summary)

- New: `supabase/migrations/<ts>_billing.sql`, `src/lib/billing/plans.ts`,
  `src/lib/billing/status.ts`, `src/lib/supabase/service.ts`,
  `src/app/business/[businessId]/billing/{page.tsx,actions.ts,pay-button.tsx}`,
  `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/layout.tsx`,
  `src/app/api/midtrans/notification/route.ts`,
  `src/app/api/cron/subscription-sweep/route.ts`, `vercel.json`.
- Modified: `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx`,
  `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/dashboard-shell.tsx` (banner
  prop), `src/app/onboarding/actions.ts`, `supabase/migrations/..._admin_panel`
  follow-up migration for the RPC change, `.env.example`.

## Verification

1. `npx eslint` + `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, as usual.
2. Apply the new migration via the Supabase SQL Editor (per the established
   manual-migration workflow) — confirm `subscriptions`/`payments` exist
   with RLS.
3. In the browser preview: sign up a fresh test account → confirm it lands
   on `/billing` (not `/dashboard`) with `status='unpaid'` and can't reach
   any dashboard/pos page directly by URL (redirected back to `/billing`).
4. Click "Bayar Sekarang" on the lifetime plan (Midtrans **Sandbox** mode,
   `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION=false`) → confirm redirect to Midtrans's sandbox
   Snap page, complete a test payment with Midtrans's documented test
   card/VA numbers.
5. Confirm the webhook fires (check Vercel/dev server logs, or if testing
   locally, simulate it with a signed `curl` POST matching the real payload
   shape) and `payments.status` flips to `settlement`, `subscriptions`
   flips to `active`, `period_end` set correctly for a subscription plan
   vs `null` for lifetime.
6. Confirm dashboard/POS are reachable again after payment.
7. Manually backdate a test row's `period_end` in the SQL Editor and hit the
   cron route directly (with the right `CRON_SECRET` header) to confirm the
   `active → past_due → expired` transitions and that the dashboard shows
   the grace-period banner, then locks out once `expired`.
8. Confirm `/admin` shows the new subscription columns for the test business.

# Billing: Midtrans subscription + lifetime purchase

## Context

KasirKu is meant to be sold to other business owners, but right now there is
**no way for anyone to pay** — no plan/subscription columns anywhere, no
payment gateway, no way to lock out a non-paying tenant (confirmed via a full
codebase audit: `businesses` table has zero billing columns, `/admin` is
read-only, `package.json` has no payment SDK). This is the launch blocker.
The user wants:

- Two kinds of paid plans: recurring **subscription** (bulanan/tahunan) and
  a **sekali-beli (lifetime)** one-time purchase.
- **Midtrans** as the gateway.
- **No trial** — a new business must pick and pay for a plan immediately
  after signup, before the dashboard is usable at all.
- On a subscription lapsing, a **grace period** (3 days) with a warning
  banner before the account is actually locked out.

Scope for this pass is "get a working, secure payment loop live fast," not a
full billing back-office. Plan prices are placeholders in code — the user
must edit them before going live; I have no real pricing input.

## Data model

New migration `supabase/migrations/<ts>_billing.sql`:

```sql
create table public.subscriptions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null unique references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  plan_code text not null,                 -- matches PLANS[].code in src/lib/billing/plans.ts
  status text not null default 'unpaid'
    check (status in ('unpaid', 'active', 'past_due', 'expired')),
  period_end timestamptz,                  -- null = lifetime / never expires
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
-- one row per business, mutated in place (mirrors how `businesses` itself works)

alter table public.subscriptions enable row level security;
create policy "Owner reads own subscription"
on public.subscriptions for select
using (private.owns_business(business_id));
-- no insert/update/delete policy for authenticated users: only the
-- service-role webhook and the cron sweep write to this table.

create table public.payments (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  plan_code text not null,
  order_id text not null unique,           -- sent to Midtrans as order_id
  amount numeric(14, 2) not null,
  status text not null default 'pending'
    check (status in ('pending', 'settlement', 'expire', 'cancel', 'deny')),
  midtrans_transaction_id text,
  payment_type text,
  raw_notification jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index payments_business_id_idx on public.payments (business_id, created_at desc);
alter table public.payments enable row level security;
create policy "Owner reads own payments"
on public.payments for select
using (private.owns_business(business_id));
create policy "Owner creates own pending payments"
on public.payments for insert
with check (private.owns_business(business_id) and status = 'pending');
-- updates to payments (settlement/expire/etc) only ever come from the
-- service-role webhook, which bypasses RLS — no update policy for
-- authenticated users.
```

Plan catalog lives in code, not the DB (fastest to ship; revisit if pricing
needs to change without a deploy):

`src/lib/billing/plans.ts`
```ts
export type PlanCode = "monthly" | "yearly" | "lifetime";
export const PLANS: {
  code: PlanCode; name: string; kind: "subscription" | "lifetime";
  periodDays: number | null; price: number;
}[] = [
  { code: "monthly", name: "Langganan Bulanan", kind: "subscription", periodDays: 30, price: 99000 },
  { code: "yearly", name: "Langganan Tahunan", kind: "subscription", periodDays: 365, price: 990000 },
  { code: "lifetime", name: "Sekali Bayar (Lifetime)", kind: "lifetime", periodDays: null, price: 2500000 },
];
```
(placeholder prices — flag clearly in the PR/summary that these must be edited)

## Shared status helper

`src/lib/billing/status.ts` — `getSubscriptionAccess(supabase, businessId)`
returns `{ locked: boolean; status: string; periodEnd: string | null }`.
Reads the `subscriptions` row for the business (none yet = `unpaid` =
`locked: true`). `locked` is true for `unpaid` and `expired`; false for
`active` and `past_due` (past_due only shows a warning, per the grace-period
decision). Used by both gating layouts below so the rule lives in one place.

## Enforcement (two independent layouts, no shared cross-cutting layout)

Next.js layouts can't easily detect "am I currently rendering the billing
page itself" from a parent layout, so instead of one `[businessId]/layout.tsx`
wrapping everything (which would redirect-loop on `/billing`), gate at the
two existing entry points that are NOT the billing page:

- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx`** (exists today,
  reads `business` + `userData`) — add `getSubscriptionAccess` to the same
  `Promise.all`, `redirect()` to `/business/${businessId}/billing` if
  `locked`. If `status === 'past_due'`, pass a warning flag into
  `DashboardShell` to render a dismissible-for-the-session banner ("Langganan
  jatuh tempo, bayar sebelum <periodEnd> agar tidak terkunci" + link to
  `/billing`).
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/layout.tsx`** (new file — pos has no
  layout today) — same `getSubscriptionAccess` redirect, no banner needed
  (cashiers don't need to see billing state, only the owner browsing the
  dashboard does).

`/order/*` (customer-facing self-order QR flow) is untouched — it's already
outside `/business/[businessId]` entirely per the middleware's public-path
list, so customers are never blocked by the owner's billing status.

## Billing page

`src/app/business/[businessId]/billing/page.tsx` (sibling to `(dashboard)`
and `pos`, so neither gating layout wraps it):
- Shows current status (from `getSubscriptionAccess`) and, if a subscription,
  the current `period_end`.
- Lists `PLANS` as cards with a "Bayar Sekarang" button per plan.
- `billing/actions.ts` → `createPayment(businessId, planCode)` server action:
  inserts a `payments` row (`status='pending'`, `order_id` =
  `KK-${businessId.slice(0,8)}-${Date.now()}`), calls Midtrans Snap
  (`POST https://app.midtrans.com/snap/v1/transactions`, Sandbox host in
  dev via `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION`) with Basic auth using
  `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`, gets back `redirect_url`, returns it to the client.
- `billing/pay-button.tsx` (client component): calls the action, then
  `window.location.href = redirectUrl` — plain redirect to Midtrans's hosted
  Snap page, no Snap.js popup SDK needed (keeps this consistent with the
  app's existing preference for server-rendered flows over client JS).
- After Midtrans payment, it redirects the browser back to a `finish` URL
  (e.g. `/business/${businessId}/billing?status=selesai`) — cosmetic only,
  not authoritative (the webhook is authoritative).

## Onboarding change

`src/app/onboarding/actions.ts` `createBusiness` currently redirects to
`/dashboard` after insert. Change: also insert a `subscriptions` row
(`status='unpaid'`, `plan_code=null` or a sentinel) for the new business,
then redirect to `/business/${id}/billing` instead of `/dashboard` — no
trial, so the very first thing a new owner sees is the plan picker.

## Midtrans webhook (new pattern: first service-role client in this codebase)

`src/app/api/midtrans/notification/route.ts` (new Route Handler, `POST`):
- Reads JSON body (`order_id`, `status_code`, `gross_amount`,
  `signature_key`, `transaction_status`, `payment_type`, `transaction_id`).
- Verifies `sha512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY) === signature_key`
  (Midtrans's documented scheme) — reject with 401 if it doesn't match.
- Uses a **service-role** Supabase client (new: `src/lib/supabase/service.ts`,
  `createClient` with `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, server-only, never
  imported client-side) since there's no authenticated user session in a
  webhook — this is the only file allowed to bypass RLS.
- Looks up `payments` by `order_id`. If already `settlement` (idempotency —
  Midtrans retries notifications), return 200 no-op.
- Maps `transaction_status`: `capture`/`settlement` → `payments.status =
  'settlement'`; `deny`/`cancel`/`expire` → mirror that status. Stores the
  full body in `raw_notification` for audit.
- On a fresh `settlement`: upsert `subscriptions` — `status='active'`;
  `period_end` = `null` for `lifetime`, else `now() + periodDays` (extending
  from the greater of `now()` or the existing `period_end` if renewing
  early, so early renewal doesn't lose paid-for days).
- Always returns 200 (Midtrans expects 2xx or it keeps retrying) even on a
  handled "unknown order_id" case — just skip silently, log via
  `console.error` (no activity-log table write needed for a webhook).

## Cron sweep (subscription → past_due → expired)

No cron infra exists yet (no `vercel.json`). Add:
- `vercel.json` at repo root: `{"crons": [{"path": "/api/cron/subscription-sweep", "schedule": "0 1 * * *"}]}`
  (once daily).
- `src/app/api/cron/subscription-sweep/route.ts` (`GET`): checks
  `request.headers.get("authorization") === \`Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}\``,
  403 if not (Vercel Cron sends this header when `CRON_SECRET` env var is
  set — documented Vercel behavior). Uses the service-role client:
  - `status='active' and period_end < now()` → `status='past_due'`.
  - `status='past_due' and period_end < now() - interval '3 days'` →
    `status='expired'`.
  - `lifetime` subscriptions (`period_end is null`) are never touched.

## Admin panel visibility (small extension, not a full billing back-office)

Extend `admin_list_businesses()` (migration, `create or replace function`) to
also return `subscription_status` and `plan_code` by left-joining
`subscriptions`, and add those two columns to the table in
`src/app/admin/page.tsx`. No manual-override UI in this pass — flag as a
fast-follow if the user needs to comp an account or handle an offline
bank-transfer edge case later.

## New env vars (document in `.env.example`, don't set real values)

- `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`, `MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY`, `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION`
  (`"true"`/`"false"`)
- `CRON_SECRET`
- `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` already exists in `.env.example`, just unused
  today — first real use is `src/lib/supabase/service.ts`.

## Files touched (summary)

- New: `supabase/migrations/<ts>_billing.sql`, `src/lib/billing/plans.ts`,
  `src/lib/billing/status.ts`, `src/lib/supabase/service.ts`,
  `src/app/business/[businessId]/billing/{page.tsx,actions.ts,pay-button.tsx}`,
  `src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/layout.tsx`,
  `src/app/api/midtrans/notification/route.ts`,
  `src/app/api/cron/subscription-sweep/route.ts`, `vercel.json`.
- Modified: `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx`,
  `src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/dashboard-shell.tsx` (banner
  prop), `src/app/onboarding/actions.ts`, `supabase/migrations/..._admin_panel`
  follow-up migration for the RPC change, `.env.example`.

## Verification

1. `npx eslint` + `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, as usual.
2. Apply the new migration via the Supabase SQL Editor (per the established
   manual-migration workflow) — confirm `subscriptions`/`payments` exist
   with RLS.
3. In the browser preview: sign up a fresh test account → confirm it lands
   on `/billing` (not `/dashboard`) with `status='unpaid'` and can't reach
   any dashboard/pos page directly by URL (redirected back to `/billing`).
4. Click "Bayar Sekarang" on the lifetime plan (Midtrans **Sandbox** mode,
   `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION=false`) → confirm redirect to Midtrans's sandbox
   Snap page, complete a test payment with Midtrans's documented test
   card/VA numbers.
5. Confirm the webhook fires (check Vercel/dev server logs, or if testing
   locally, simulate it with a signed `curl` POST matching the real payload
   shape) and `payments.status` flips to `settlement`, `subscriptions`
   flips to `active`, `period_end` set correctly for a subscription plan
   vs `null` for lifetime.
6. Confirm dashboard/POS are reachable again after payment.
7. Manually backdate a test row's `period_end` in the SQL Editor and hit the
   cron route directly (with the right `CRON_SECRET` header) to confirm the
   `active → past_due → expired` transitions and that the dashboard shows
   the grace-period banner, then locks out once `expired`.
8. Confirm `/admin` shows the new subscription columns for the test business.

# Billing: Midtrans subscription + lifetime purchase

## Context

KasirKu is meant to be sold to other business owners, but right now there is
**no way for anyone to pay** — no plan/subscription columns anywhere, no
payment gateway, no way to lock out a non-paying tenant (confirmed via a full
codebase audit: `businesses` table has zero billing columns, `/admin` is
read-only, `package.json` has no payment SDK). This is the launch blocker.
The user wants:

- Two kinds of paid plans: recurring **subscription** (bulanan/tahunan) and
  a **sekali-beli (lifetime)** one-time purchase.
- **Midtrans** as the gateway.
- **No trial** — a new business must pick and pay for a plan immediately
  after signup, before the dashboard is usable at all.
- On a subscription lapsing, a **grace period** (3 days) with a warning
  banner before the account is actually locked out.

Scope for this pass is "get a working, secure payment loop live fast," not a
full billing back-office. Plan prices are placeholders in code — the user
must edit them before going live; I have no real pricing input.

## Data model

New migration `supabase/migrations/<ts>_billing.sql`:

```sql
create table public.subscriptions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null unique references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  plan_code text not null,                 -- matches PLANS[].code in src/lib/billing/plans.ts
  status text not null default 'unpaid'
    check (status in ('unpaid', 'active', 'past_due', 'expired')),
  period_end timestamptz,                  -- null = lifetime / never expires
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
-- one row per business, mutated in place (mirrors how `businesses` itself works)

alter table public.subscriptions enable row level security;
create policy "Owner reads own subscription"
on public.subscriptions for select
using (private.owns_business(business_id));
-- no insert/update/delete policy for authenticated users: only the
-- service-role webhook and the cron sweep write to this table.

create table public.payments (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  business_id uuid not null references public.businesses (id) on delete cascade,
  plan_code text not null,
  order_id text not null unique,           -- sent to Midtrans as order_id
  amount numeric(14, 2) not null,
  status text not null default 'pending'
    check (status in ('pending', 'settlement', 'expire', 'cancel', 'deny')),
  midtrans_transaction_id text,
  payment_type text,
  raw_notification jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index payments_business_id_idx on public.payments (business_id, created_at desc);
alter table public.payments enable row level security;
create policy "Owner reads own payments"
on public.payments for select
using (private.owns_business(business_id));
create policy "Owner creates own pending payments"
on public.payments for insert
with check (private.owns_business(business_id) and status = 'pending');
-- updates to payments (settlement/expire/etc) only ever come from the
-- service-role webhook, which bypasses RLS — no update policy for
-- authenticated users.
```

Plan catalog lives in code, not the DB (fastest to ship; revisit if pricing
needs to change without a deploy):

`src/lib/billing/plans.ts`
```ts
export type PlanCode = "monthly" | "yearly" | "lifetime";
export const PLANS: {
  code: PlanCode; name: string; kind: "subscription" | "lifetime";
  periodDays: number | null; price: number;
}[] = [
  { code: "monthly", name: "Langganan Bulanan", kind: "subscription", periodDays: 30, price: 99000 },
  { code: "yearly", name: "Langganan Tahunan", kind: "subscription", periodDays: 365, price: 990000 },
  { code: "lifetime", name: "Sekali Bayar (Lifetime)", kind: "lifetime", periodDays: null, price: 2500000 },
];
```
(placeholder prices — flag clearly in the PR/summary that these must be edited)

## Shared status helper

`src/lib/billing/status.ts` — `getSubscriptionAccess(supabase, businessId)`
returns `{ locked: boolean; status: string; periodEnd: string | null }`.
Reads the `subscriptions` row for the business (none yet = `unpaid` =
`locked: true`). `locked` is true for `unpaid` and `expired`; false for
`active` and `past_due` (past_due only shows a warning, per the grace-period
decision). Used by both gating layouts below so the rule lives in one place.

## Enforcement (two independent layouts, no shared cross-cutting layout)

Next.js layouts can't easily detect "am I currently rendering the billing
page itself" from a parent layout, so instead of one `[businessId]/layout.tsx`
wrapping everything (which would redirect-loop on `/billing`), gate at the
two existing entry points that are NOT the billing page:

- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/(dashboard)/layout.tsx`** (exists today,
  reads `business` + `userData`) — add `getSubscriptionAccess` to the same
  `Promise.all`, `redirect()` to `/business/${businessId}/billing` if
  `locked`. If `status === 'past_due'`, pass a warning flag into
  `DashboardShell` to render a dismissible-for-the-session banner ("Langganan
  jatuh tempo, bayar sebelum <periodEnd> agar tidak terkunci" + link to
  `/billing`).
- **`src/app/business/[businessId]/pos/layout.tsx`** (new file — pos has no
  layout today) — same `getSubscriptionAccess` redirect, no banner needed
  (cashiers don't need to see billing state, only the owner browsing the
  dashboard does).

`/order/*` (customer-facing self-order QR flow) is untouched — it's already
outside `/business/[businessId]` entirely per the middleware's public-path
list, so customers are never blocked by the owner's billing status.

## Billing page

`src/app/business/[businessId]/billing/page.tsx` (sibling to `(dashboard)`
and `pos`, so neither gating layout wraps it):
- Shows current status (from `getSubscriptionAccess`) and, if a subscription,
  the current `period_end`.
- Lists `PLANS` as cards with a "Bayar Sekarang" button per plan.
- `billing/actions.ts` → `createPayment(businessId, planCode)` server action:
  inserts a `payments` row (`status='pending'`, `order_id` =
  `KK-${businessId.slice(0,8)}-${Date.now()}`), calls Midtrans Snap
  (`POST https://app.midtrans.com/snap/v1/transactions`, Sandbox host in
  dev via `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION`) with Basic auth using
  `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`, gets back `redirect_url`, returns it to the client.
- `billing/pay-button.tsx` (client component): calls the action, then
  `window.location.href = redirectUrl` — plain redirect to Midtrans's hosted
  Snap page, no Snap.js popup SDK needed (keeps this consistent with the
  app's existing preference for server-rendered flows over client JS).
- After Midtrans payment, it redirects the browser back to a `finish` URL
  (e.g. `/business/${businessId}/billing?status=selesai`) — cosmetic only,
  not authoritative (the webhook is authoritative).

## Onboarding change

`src/app/onboarding/actions.ts` `createBusiness` currently redirects to
`/dashboard` after insert. Change: also insert a `subscriptions` row
(`status='unpaid'`, `plan_code=null` or a sentinel) for the new business,
then redirect to `/business/${id}/billing` instead of `/dashboard` — no
trial, so the very first thing a new owner sees is the plan picker.

## Midtrans webhook (new pattern: first service-role client in this codebase)

`src/app/api/midtrans/notification/route.ts` (new Route Handler, `POST`):
- Reads JSON body (`order_id`, `status_code`, `gross_amount`,
  `signature_key`, `transaction_status`, `payment_type`, `transaction_id`).
- Verifies `sha512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY) === signature_key`
  (Midtrans's documented scheme) — reject with 401 if it doesn't match.
- Uses a **service-role** Supabase client (new: `src/lib/supabase/service.ts`,
  `createClient` with `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, server-only, never
  imported client-side) since there's no authenticated user session in a
  webhook — this is the only file allowed to bypass RLS.
- Looks up `payments` by `order_id`. If already `settlement` (idempotency —
  Midtrans retries notifications), return 200 no-op.
- Maps `transaction_status`: `capture`/`settlement` → `payments.status =
  'settlement'`; `deny`/`cancel`/`expire` → mirror that status. Stores the
  full body in `raw_notification` for audit.
- On a fresh `settlement`: upsert `subscriptions` — `status='active'`;
  `period_end` = `null` for `lifetime`, else `now() + periodDays` (extending
  from the greater of `now()` or the existing `period_end` if renewing
  early, so early renewal doesn't lose paid-for days).
- Always returns 200 (Midtrans expects 2xx or it keeps retrying) even on a
  handled "unknown order_id" case — just skip silently, log via
  `console.error` (no activity-log table write needed for a webhook).

## Cron sweep (subscription → past_due → expired)

No cron infra exists yet (no `vercel.json`). Add:
- `vercel.json` at repo root: `{"crons": [{"path": "/api/cron/subscription-sweep", "schedule": "0 1 * * *"}]}`
  (once daily).
- `src/app/api/cron/subscription-sweep/route.ts` (`GET`): checks
  `request.headers.get("authorization") === \`Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}\``,
  403 if not (Vercel Cron sends this header when `CRON_SECRET` env var is
  set — documented Vercel behavior). Uses the service-role client:
  - `status='active' and period_end < now()` → `status='past_due'`.
  - `status='past_due' and period_end < now() - interval '3 days'` →
    `status='expired'`.
  - `lifetime` subscriptions (`period_end is null`) are never touched.

## Admin panel visibility (small extension, not a full billing back-office)

Extend `admin_list_businesses()` (migration, `create or replace function`) to
also return `subscription_status` and `plan_code` by left-joining
`subscriptions`, and add those two columns to the table in
`src/app/admin/page.tsx`. No manual-override UI in this pass — flag as a
fast-follow if the user needs to comp an account or handle an offline
bank-transfer edge case later.

## New env vars (document in `.env.example`, don't set real values)

- `MIDTRANS_SERVER_KEY`, `MIDTRANS_CLIENT_KEY`, `MIDTRANS_IS_PRODUCTION`
  (`"true"`/`"false"`)
- `CRON_SECRET`
- `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` already exists in `.env.example`, just unused
